title: Being nowhere dense is a local property on an open cover
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a subset is nowhere dense in a topological space exactly when it is nowhere dense in every member of a given open cover (author lemma at source lines 4256-4263, label lemma-nowhere-dense-local). The proof (source lines 4265-4276) proves the easy direction by the lemma on open subspaces and the converse by testing an interior point of the closure against a member of the cover (proof lines 4265-4275). The localisation argument is the content. H2.
